description: This file defines extension methods for configuring custom storage-based log consistency providers within the Orleans silo builder. It provides methods to add default and named custom storage providers, configuring services and options accordingly.

classes.name: CustomStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring custom storage log consistency providers in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a custom storage log consistency provider as the default provider for the silo builder.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a custom storage log consistency provider with a specified name and optional primary cluster.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method that configures services to add a custom storage log consistency provider with specified name and primary cluster.
